blocks.text: Emerging technologies woh nayi aur jadeed ijadaat (innovations) hain jo logon ke rehne, kaam karne aur rabta karne ka tareeqa badal rahi hain. Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Cloud Computing aur Blockchain jaisi technologies industries ko nayi shakal de rahi hain aur data, automation aur connectivity (aapas mein jure rehna) sambhalne ke liye zyada smart systems bana rahi hain (Figure 8.1). Yeh technologies sehat (healthcare), taleem, transport aur zaraat mein nayi ijaad la rahi hain aur kaam tez aur behtar bana rahi hain. Aaj ke digital daur mein in technologies ko samajhna bohat zaroori hai. Yeh duniya aur mulk ke masail ke naye hal deti hain, lekin data ki hifazat, akhlaqi fikr aur automation par zyada inhisar jaise naye masle bhi lati hain. In technologies ke baare mein seekh kar log in ki salahiyat samajh sakte hain, aane wali tabdeeliyon ki tayyari kar sakte hain, aur inhein zimmedari se muashre ki behtari ke liye use kar sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Darmiyani daira 'smarter systems' chaar dabbon se jura: Artificial Intelligence (data se seekhti; faisla karti), Internet of Things (devices mehsoos aur amal karte), Cloud Computing (online storage aur computing) aur Blockchain (mushtarka, na-qabil-e-tabdeel records). Note: yeh sehat, taleem, naql-o-haml aur zara'at mein use hoti aur hifazat aur akhlaqi sawal bhi uthati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.1: AI, IoT, cloud computing aur blockchain mil kar jadeed duniya bana rahi hain (kitab ki Figure 8.1 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chaaron aksar mil jati hain: IoT devices data jama karte, cloud mehfooz karta, AI us se seekhti aur blockchain qabil-e-bharosa record rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: AI, IoT, Cloud Computing aur Blockchain jaisi emerging technologies agla digital inqilab (revolution) bana rahi hain, aur duniya bhar ke logon, data aur devices ko jor rahi hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Emerging technology ka matlab hai woh nayi technology jo abhi tezi se barh rahi hai aur aane wale waqt mein bohat kuch badal degi. Is section mein chaar aisi technologies hain: AI (sochne wali machines), IoT (internet se jure devices), Cloud (internet par storage aur computing) aur Blockchain (jure hue mehfooz records). Figure 8.1 dikhati hai ke yeh chaaron aksar mil kar kaam karti hain.

blocks.prompt: Emerging technologies ke do fawaid aur do naye masle (issues) batayein jo kitab ne likhe hain.
blocks.explanation: Fawaid: healthcare, taleem, transport aur zaraat mein kaam tez aur behtar (efficient) hote hain; duniya aur mulk ke masail ke naye hal milte hain. Masle: data security (data ki hifazat), ethical concerns (akhlaqi fikr) aur automation par zyada inhisar (dependence).

items: Emerging technologies: AI, IoT, Cloud Computing, Blockchain; data, automation aur connectivity ke smart systems.
Fawaid ke saath masle bhi: data security, akhlaqi sawal, automation par inhisar.
